title: Architecture
content:
Build and delivery

authorized material
  → evidence admission
  → SemanticProposal
  → validation and review
  → KnowledgeRevision
  ├→ 3D ontology graph → human review
  └→ CognitivePackageDraft → A3S Use generation → A3S Code / Agent

Domain model {#domain-model}

Workspace: authority boundary for organizational knowledge, grants, and ontology revisions.

KnowledgeScope: the material, version, and processing boundary admitted to one build.

Evidence: admitted, citable material.

SemanticProposal: a candidate concept, relationship, or claim proposed by an Agent.

KnowledgeRevision: an immutable knowledge revision compiled after validation.

CognitivePackageDraft: a schema-v3 package draft compiled from a revision, containing surfaces such as OKF and Skill.

Package generation: the exact package installed, locked, and published by A3S Use for Agents.

The 3D graph is a human-review projection of KnowledgeRevision, not an Agent query interface.

A3S component boundaries

Component	Role	Does not own
A3S Use	Validate the package, resolve dependencies, then install, lock, and publish a generation	Generate or approve the ontology
A3S Code	Run ontology Agents and host business Agents against an exact generation	Read the 3D graph directly
A3S Flow	Keep durable exploration, ingestion, compilation, and evaluation history	Knowledge authority
A3S Cloud	Deploy roles, nodes, routes, Secrets, and Runtime Tasks	KnowledgeScope or ontology revisions

Quality {#quality}

Quality covers citation completeness, authorization correctness, reproducible revisions and package generations, language/version parity, and prevention of implementation disclosure in public artifacts.

title: Agentic Ontology documentation
content:
Agentic Ontology compiles authorized documents into ontology revisions and produces two artifacts from each revision: a 3D graph for human review and a schema-v3 cognitive package for A3S Use. Agents do not access the graph. They consume an exact package generation installed, locked, and published by A3S Use.

Current public surface

The product site explains the path from documents and evidence to an ontology revision and cognitive package.

The 3D Playground uses mock semantic data to demonstrate the complete interaction model.

A public artifact generator produces the Playground contract and can later accept real semantic build output.

Public artifacts contain no source code, code snippets, repository paths, line numbers, Git history, or source maps.

Playground counts, timestamps, relationships, and package content are demo data. They are not production scale, performance, or delivery claims. No package is installed, locked, or published yet.

title: Playground
content:
The Playground demonstrates the complete Agentic Ontology product shape; it is not a source-code browser. It currently uses build-generated mock data, with all demo values labelled honestly.

Three linked regions

Agent learning events

The left ledger records when an Agent read a public document, which knowledge it understood, which semantics it created, and which Ontology Revision received the change. Selecting an event highlights related graph nodes and edges.

Semantic 3D ontology

The center graph colors semantic classes and supports search, filtering, camera focus, neighborhood highlighting, and recentering. An accessible node list preserves navigation when WebGL is unavailable.

Cognitive-package preview

The right panel shows the schema-v3 cognitive package planned from the current KnowledgeRevision, including its package identity, OKF and Skill surfaces, and A3S Use install, lock, and publication state.

Delivery boundary {#delivery-boundary}

The graph is only for human search, focus, review, and traceability.

Agents do not access the graph, and no public graph-query payload exists.

The package draft binds its KnowledgeRevision and lists its OKF and Skill surfaces.

A3S Code only consumes an exact generation installed, locked, and published by A3S Use.

title: Quick start
content:
Requirements

Node.js 22 or newer

npm 11

Local development

npm install
npm run dev

The product site uses /agentic-ontology/ as its default repository base path. To work on the 3D Playground directly:

npm run dev:playground

Build every static artifact

npm run build

The build generates the public semantic artifact, builds the Playground, product site, and versioned docs, assembles them under website/doc_build/, and then runs route and privacy checks.

First verification

Open the product home and confirm Simplified Chinese is the default.

Open the Playground and select a learning event.

Confirm the 3D graph highlights related nodes and relationships.

Inspect the cognitive-package preview and confirm that it is marked draft, not installed, not locked, and not published.

title: Versioning
content:
Documentation versions both product state and language. The default version and default language use paths without prefixes.

Content	Path
v0.1 Simplified Chinese	/agentic-ontology/docs/
v0.1 English	/agentic-ontology/docs/en/
next Simplified Chinese	/agentic-ontology/docs/next/
next English	/agentic-ontology/docs/next/en/

v0.1 records the current demo contract. next describes unreleased evolution. Every version must contain the same page set in Chinese and English; the build fails on translation-page drift.
